summary: Done: recorded the bounded two-room active WORK-to-PLAN queue smoke test. WORK tasks 01a06123-7bb2-7e12-b8fc-1efeaa8d99cc and 01a06123-d366-7a93-b57a-3291cf673b98 returned distinct handoffs to PLAN task 01a05e34-5b16-7493-ac31-9baf8ba71454 with mcp__codex_app.send_message_to_thread. PLAN queued alpha as arrivalSequence 1 and beta as arrivalSequence 2, then processed both read-only handoffs one at a time. The result proves only projectless read-only multi-WORK queue liveness on this local host.
